build_colqwen2_retrieval_model: build a ColQwen2ForRetrieval model from a ColQwen2Config for document image retrieval
initialize_model_weights: initialize model weights for linear, conv2d, and embedding modules using the _init_weights method
generate_document_embeddings: generate L2-normalized multi-vector embeddings from document images and text input ids
create_retrieval_output: create a ColQwen2ForRetrievalOutput containing embeddings, past_key_values, hidden_states, and attentions
run_forward_with_pixel_values: run the forward pass with pixel values and image_grid_thw to produce document retrieval embeddings
